↗
Your one job

Borrow patterns that already work without copying another company's claims or design.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Ask ChatGPT to identify established operators in the same category worldwide.

  2. 02

    Open primary company websites and record their actual offer, pricing structure, acquisition channels, delivery model and differentiation.

  3. 03

    Ask which methods could work in your smaller market and which rely on scale, capital or regulations you do not have.

  4. 04

    Save links, screenshots/date checked and gaps as a comparative table.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Research the strongest business models globally for [BUSINESS CATEGORY]. Find 3–5 actual companies and cite current primary-source URLs. Compare what they sell, who buys, how they charge, acquisition/distribution, fulfillment and what makes the model defensible. Distinguish observed facts from hypotheses. Then explain which tactics would realistically transfer to [MY COUNTRY], and which would not. If live browsing is unavailable, return a research plan instead of invented findings.
03

Finish with this

Global benchmark table with 3–5 real companies and transferable tactics.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Source links exist for each competitor
  • Pricing/status are dated or marked unknown
  • Transferable methods are not confused with proof of local demand
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Copying Silicon Valley economics into a small island market unchanged.

READY TO MOVE ON?

At least three relevant alternatives are documented; there's a plausible customer gap and a way to test it.
